response.text: The accrual pairs are small rounding differences (1 cent) and look like normal manual accruals in the same journal, which is a rounding quirk rather than a demonstrated error, so I won't report them as findings. I have enough demonstrated problems now.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT" FROM public."APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (28,802,557,801)
findings.summary: Same vendor invoice recorded twice: V0024 invoice 65026-28 (INV_ID 28 and 802, 19556.55 each, same date) and V0010 invoice 94645-557 (INV_ID 557 and 801, 1245.08 each, same date). Keys differ only by padding/leading space/trailing space in the text.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM public."GLJRNH" h JOIN public."GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journals 2462 (period 4, posted 20240525) and 2463 (period 7, posted 20240808) were posted after their period close dates (20240505 and 20240805) while the periods are status C (closed).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM public."APINVH" i JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN public."GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE trim(c."ACCT_CD")='2000' GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l."CR_AMT",0)) <> i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 742 (journal 2215) has invoice amount 13307.11 but the AP control (2000) credit in its journal is 13352.11, a 45.00 difference. This accounts for the 45.00 gap between invoice totals and AP control credits.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(COALESCE(p."PAY_AMT",0)) AS paid FROM public."APINVH" i LEFT JOIN public."APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID"=78 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p."PAY_AMT",0)) <> i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 78 is marked paid but its payments total 7122.95 against an invoice amount of 7122.94, a 0.01 overpayment.
